name: Rhode Island

context: RI 340: Cover crop use in RI is to reduce wind and water erosion, among other purposes.
RI 380: Windbreaks protect a zone 10H on the leeward side and 2H on the windward side.
cover_rules: RI 340: For erosion control, combined canopy and surface residue cover of 90 percent or greater is best during the period of erosive wind or rainfall.
RI 340: Time cover crop establishment with other practices to protect soil in the critical erosion period.
windbreak: RI 380: Plant species taller than the crop; orient the windbreak perpendicular to the wind that causes the problem.

cover.name: Winter rye
cover.note: The most reliable cool season cover crop; often mixed with hairy vetch or red clover.

cover.name: Oats
cover.note: Used as spring and fall cover; they winterkill in RI.

cover.name: Barley
cover.note: Good at controlling erosion; may winterkill in RI.

RI seeding dates: cool season grass in fall 8/20-10/1 in zones 6a and 6b, 9/1-10/15 in zone 7a.
